about: The CUPTI counters of EnergyProbes, in one place. ModelCounters() (ProbeKernels.cpp) collects every name here,
tools/energy_model.py computes the events from them, tools/check_counters.py and tools/check_run.py report them.
A counter feeds model events ('feeds') or is a check or a study ('use'). 'alias_of': the same counter under
another chip's name (the program stores it under the canonical name). 'alternative': a different counter that a
GPU has instead (fp16 on its own pipe or inside the fma pipe); one of the two must exist. 'group': an optional
group of counters that older runs lack (the model then counts their events together). 'min_cc': the counter
does not exist below this compute capability, so a GPU below it does not miss it. 'only_with': only that option
uses it. A new counter goes here first.

counters.name: l1tex__t_sector_hit_rate.pct
counters.use: level check: share of L1 sectors that hit (check_run.py, the counter table of a run)

counters.name: lts__t_sector_hit_rate.pct
counters.use: level check: share of L2 sectors that hit (check_run.py, the counter table of a run)

counters.name: lts__t_sectors_op_read.sum
counters.use: level check: L2 sectors of all sources (check_run.py, the counter table of a run)

counters.name: lts__t_sectors_op_write.sum
counters.use: level check: L2 sectors of all sources (check_run.py, the counter table of a run)

counters.name: lts__t_requests_srcunit_tex_op_atom_lookup_miss.sum
counters.feeds: L2 read miss request, L2 partial write miss request

counters.name: lts__t_requests_srcunit_tex_op_red_lookup_miss.sum
counters.feeds: L2 read miss request, L2 partial write miss request

counters.name: dram__sectors_write.sum
counters.feeds: DRAM write sector, L2 partial write miss request

counters.name: dram__sectors_op_read.sum
counters.exists: GB202 (RTX 5090): the DRAM sectors under this name, untested

counters.name: dram__sectors_op_write.sum
counters.exists: GB202 (RTX 5090): the DRAM sectors under this name, untested

counters.name: idc__requests_lookup_miss_tag_miss.sum
counters.note: not idc__requests_lookup_hit: it is requests minus lookup misses, and a miss that finds no free tag is replayed and looked up again, so on an RTX 3090 it came out negative

counters.name: smsp__thread_inst_executed.sum
counters.use: no event: threads per instruction (lane activity)

counters.name: smsp__thread_inst_executed_pred_on.sum
counters.use: no event: threads per instruction with a true guard (lane activity)

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_pipe_alu.sum
counters.feeds: inst alu (warp count; lanes from sm__thread_..._alu_pred_on)

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_pipe_fma_type_fp16.sum
counters.feeds: inst fp16 (fp16 inside the fma pipe; taken out of inst fma)
counters.exists: GA10x and newer: fp16 inside the fma pipe

counters.name: sm__thread_inst_executed_pipe_fma_type_fp16_pred_on.sum
counters.feeds: inst fp16 (active lanes; fp16 inside the fma pipe)
counters.exists: GA10x and newer: fp16 inside the fma pipe

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_pipe_fp16.sum
counters.exists: Volta, Turing, GA100: fp16 on a pipe of its own
counters.feeds: inst fp16 (fp16 on a pipe of its own; taken out of inst other)

counters.name: sm__thread_inst_executed_pipe_fp16_pred_on.sum
counters.exists: Volta, Turing, GA100: fp16 on a pipe of its own
counters.feeds: inst fp16 (active lanes; fp16 on a pipe of its own)

counters.name: sm__thread_inst_executed_pipe_fmaheavy_pred_on.sum
counters.exists: GA10x and newer GeForce: the fma pipe in two halves (fmaheavy: FP32 and IMAD, fmalite: FP32)

counters.name: sm__thread_inst_executed_pipe_fmalite_pred_on.sum
counters.exists: GA10x and newer GeForce: the fma pipe in two halves (fmaheavy: FP32 and IMAD, fmalite: FP32)

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_op_ldc.sum
counters.use: no event: constant loads (LDC) are not on the lsu pipe; checks the constant probe

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_pipe_cbu.sum
counters.use: no event: control pipe (the loop branch is not on it on GA102)

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_pipe_adu.sum
counters.use: no event: address unit, counted in inst other

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_pipe_uniform.sum
counters.use: no event: uniform datapath, counted in inst other

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_op_branch.sum
counters.use: no event: branches count as inst other (the counter checks the ffma-loop probe)

counters.name: smsp__warps_issue_stalled_long_scoreboard.sum
counters.use: no event: cycles warps wait for L1TEX (the stall event was priced 0 and dropped)
